R25.title: The witness signs a checkpoint of a baseline's chain: how many decisions it holds, the hash of the last, and its clock.  A record carries one, and its checker requires it to be the witness's and to name the record's own head.  Against a checkpoint obtained separately, the checker says whether a record is current, out of date or of another chain; and a log of checkpoints kept apart from the service refuses a rollback or a fork, and keeps the evidence. R26.title:
A courier that reads only the witness sends the engineer a notice of each run that calls for one, signed with its own key,
    to the engineer's mailbox, which signs a receipt for it.  It does not read the service, so a notice the service did not
    write, or that was removed from its inbox, is still sent.  A record can carry the notices and receipts, and its checker
    says which runs have a notice delivered and which have none.  (Amendment 11.)
